title: A Short Review of Ethical Challenges in Clinical Natural Language Processing
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper is a review of ethical challenges and does not conduct any benchmark measurements.
findings: The paper does not discuss or analyze any aspects of religion or faith. Its focus is on ethical challenges in clinical NLP, such as data privacy, access, and various types of bias (sampling, reporting, observational) that are not related to religion.
